create_R2N2_dataset: create an R2N2 dataset object with train split, shapenet directory, r2n2 directory, and splits file
load_model_by_index: load a 3D model by index from the R2N2 dataset with optional view indices and voxels
render_R2N2_models: render R2N2 dataset models using BlenderCamera with specified view indices and HardPhongShader
compute_camera_calibration: compute rotation and translation matrices from an extrinsic ShapeNet to PyTorch3D transformation matrix
review_R2N2_class: review the R2N2 class that loads 3D models, renderings, and voxelized data from the R2N2 dataset
